7622.title: Palette capture consumes printable search keystrokes
7622.rootCauseOneLine: The palette's dialog capture handler matches and cancels printable editing events before the search input can receive them.
7622.proposedFix: Skip printable unmodified editing events in the palette capture handler, reusing the existing editable-target predicate.
7622.caveats: DOM event reproduction, not a native-browser or third-party-plugin navigation test; repeated by the same agent in a second clean checkout.
